blocks.html: This Halloween season, Robinsons Malls invites everyone to a spook-tacular celebration filled with fun, frights, and festive surprises! Transforming into the ultimate Halloween playground, Robinsons Malls offers a wide array of activities for kids, families, movie lovers, and even pets—making it the perfect destination for Halloween 2025.

blocks.cap: Get your spooky toys and accessories at Toys “R” Us in select Robinsons Malls

blocks.html: Children of all ages can look forward to a magical day of costumes, candies, and captivating entertainment as Robinsons Malls brings back its highly anticipated Trick-or-Treat festivities. Young participants are encouraged to dress up in their most creative or scariest Halloween outfits for a chance to win exciting prizes.

blocks.cap: Find cute Halloween trinkets at Flying Tiger in Robinsons Galleria and Robinsons Manila.

blocks.html: The Halloween fun doesn't stop there—magic shows, face painting, and art activities will also be available throughout the day, ensuring a delightful experience for every child. To participate, simply register through the RMalls+ app from October 15 to 25. On the day of the event, guests must present their registration pass along with a qualified purchase receipt to access the Halloween activities.

blocks.cap: Get your Halloween costumes and decor at Robinsons Department Store.

blocks.html: Halloween isn’t just for kids—pets are welcome to join the fun, too! Dress up your beloved pets in their cutest or creepiest costumes and bring them to the Horror Pets-tival. This special event offers pet-friendly games, pet trick-or-treating, and take-home goodies.

blocks.cap: Treat yourself to wickedly good desserts at M Bakery in Opus Mall.

blocks.html: For thrill-seekers and horror fans, Robinsons Movieworld proudly presents the Horrorkada Film Fest, now in its fourth year. From October 29 to November 4, audiences can enjoy blockbuster horror films from the Conjuring universe at only PHP200: The Conjuring, Annabelle Comes Home, The Conjuring 2, and The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It. Adding to the thrill, select Robinsons Malls will also host special midnight screenings on November 1—a must for die-hard horror fans.

blocks.cap: Horror fans are in for a treat at Robinsons Movieworld’s Horrorkada Film Fest.

blocks.html: For families seeking spooky but kid-friendly entertainment, don’t miss the exclusive theatrical re-release of the Oscar-nominated stop-motion classic ParaNorman. Catch it at Robinsons Movieworld from October 23 to October 28 only.

blocks.cap: Grab your Halloween treats at Aji Ichiban in Robinsons Magnolia and Opus Mall.
Power up your Halloween fun with games and prizes at Dave & Buster’s in Opus Mall!

blocks.html: Keep the excitement going with visits to Robinsons Malls’ top family-friendly attractions. Enjoy games, rides, and interactive play at Timezone, Jollyland, Playlab, Kidzoona, Funtopia Park, and Quantum. Wind down with a cozy movie at the country’s first Family Cinema in Opus, perfect for little ones and family bonding.

blocks.cap: Indulge in frightfully sweet treats from J.CO Donuts at select Robinsons Malls.

blocks.html: Need the perfect Halloween décor or costume? Discover delightful finds and fun surprises at Toys “R” Us, Flying Tiger, Daiso Japan, and Robinsons Department Store. Cap off the day with sweet treats from J.CO Donuts, M Bakery, and Aji Ichiban, then enjoy all-out “eatertainment” at Dave & Buster’s.

blocks.cap: DIY your pet’s Halloween look from Daiso Japan at select Robinsons Malls.

blocks.html: Whether you’re a child in costume, a pet in disguise, a horror movie fan, or a family looking for festive fun, Robinsons Malls’ Halloween Chills and Thrills promises an unforgettable celebration for all. Make this Halloween your most memorable one yet—only at Robinsons Malls.
